latePayment.name: Late-Payment Classification
latePayment.metricSource: models/late_payment_model_metadata.json, reports/late_payment_test_metrics.json, and recomputed from test labels + saved prediction probabilities.

paymentDelay.name: Payment-Delay Regression
paymentDelay.selection: Option B refit on train+val; hyperparameters frozen from validation; test evaluated once

pca.note: Axes are clipped to the 1st–99th percentile for readability. Outlier customers outside this range are not hidden from the count; they are outside the plotted view.

methodology.note: Metrics shown are copied from recorded model metadata and reports. ROC-AUC, PR-AUC, curves and confusion matrices are recomputed from the saved test predictions.
methodology.threshold: The 0.45 classification decision threshold is used for the binary late/on-time label. The operational risk bands (Low < 0.30, Medium 0.30–0.70, High ≥ 0.70) are separate and do not alter that decision.
methodology.disclaimer: Historical model performance is not a guarantee of individual prediction accuracy. Predictions support prioritisation and planning and should not be the sole basis for adverse customer decisions.
